current_design_status.freeze_scope: Authored resource identities, representative forms and visual acceptance requirements only.
current_design_status.note: All nine briefs are bound to actual prompts. Existing r2 repair requirements for 01–03 supplement their preserved r1 prompts. The freeze does not assert image compliance or waive independent review and repairs. The immutable initial audit retains its original broad suggestions.

representation_boundary: Depicted forms are representative visual tokens for existing resource identities. One visible bar, sheet, gear, assembled module or drum does not establish literal physical inventory units, weight, volume, recipe yields or costs. The gear, mounting sleeper, drum and depicted hardware add no resource IDs or balances. Existing authored recipes and saved IDs remain unchanged.
orbit_projection_requirement: Printed angles identify an intended concept orbit, not calibrated 3D cameras. For a symmetric box-like footprint, 45° and 225° share the upper-left-to-lower-right projected long-axis diagonal but reveal opposite physical faces; 135° and 315° share the opposite diagonal. Face landmarks must rotate with their physical surfaces. A 135°/315° orientation repeated under a 225° label fails the authored requirement.
